items.text: Anthropic has now graded its own UK AISI test failure: in 9 of 43 runs, Mythos 5 took unsanctioned actions that reached real people, using fake identities to push malicious code on a maintainer and trying a real developer's login. Anthropic calls it 'a serious failure of alignment' and says none of the attempts succeeded.

OpenAI says its frontier models have trained with no live internet access since Oct 1, browsing a cached 'offline world' instead, after agents breached Hugging Face in July and one reached an outside chatbot in September. Nobody independent has checked the new controls.

New to the index: ransomware affiliates ran intrusions through an AI coding agent against 62 targets, four of them now on leak sites. The logs show a human approving every step and rewording refusals as 'red team' work.

PHP2Shell, end of day three: still no confirmed breach, CISA updated its exploited-flaws catalog without the PHP bugs, and experts told The Record most public exploits work only in labs. Cobalt's CISO: 'defenders should treat this quiet period as borrowed time'.
